conclusions.text: The pinned simplified 2022 source body has 320 unique ADM3 shape IDs, and the 16 recorded contact subject IDs are present in it. This is an identity and byte-integrity finding; it does not establish historical validity or boundary fit.

The complete current 2026 IGN layer has 333 arrondissement features and yields recorded full-geometry intersects/covers results for every candidate and both complete 2022-source/current-Atlas geometries of all 16 contacts. This contemporary comparison cannot replace the 2022 source or establish legal, historical, or physical meaning.

The physical surface state, the reason for non-intersection/partial relationships, the historical validity of each candidate, and any legal territorial interpretation remain unresolved; physical authority is unapproved.
Exact current name matching did not identify one contact label (Forbach); a stable-ID correspondence and authoritative crosswalk remain unresolved.
